description: Development-only public command appearance and interaction inventory; ls/list aliases inherit canonical routes in bin/t COMMAND_GROUPS, including config workflow and root list/ls; the repos family is removed. default.notes: Default is unattached CLI and unloaded desktop sessions. Ctrl-T selects attached-only and Ctrl-U selects unattached-only, both preserving column filters. Ctrl-F restores unattached/default and clears column filters; Ctrl-A shows all and clears filters. Dedicated searchable value pickers: Ctrl-G agent, Ctrl-P progress, Ctrl-D interface, Ctrl-B model, Ctrl-O host, Ctrl-R repository, Ctrl-V session/slot, Ctrl-E context, Ctrl-W task. Progress follows the displayed continued-work marker, not current computation or completion. Filters combine within the snapshot, preserve search, and clear hidden marks. Plain selection checks remain separate from row context marks. Retain compact session/task rows without LAST TURN, preview, or new-session controls. Every shortcut and a focused row remain visible at narrow sizes, abbreviating Ctrl as ^ and active values as a count; the value picker shows the current value.

explicit.notes: Fresh unused local slots and locally reserved desktop reopens tolerate unavailable remote hosts. Desktop claims scan once and still reject known remote owners and failed local ownership checks. Unreserved existing workspace claims retain strict ownership checks; explicit session resume warns and skips unavailable hosts while checking known owners. Automatic fresh-slot allocation skips known remote desktop reservations from one discovery snapshot; explicit slot requests still refuse conflicting owners.

default.notes: Independent Ctrl-G agent, Ctrl-O host/origin, and Ctrl-R repository facets; open/close also support Ctrl-D interface. All/default clears facets, preserves search, and removes hidden marks. No additional discovery or scope expansion. Unavailable registered hosts warn and are skipped; discovery retains local and reachable rows. Saved resumes retain local locks and known-owner checks, but cannot verify ownership on unavailable hosts. Local scan failures remain fatal. Default order is actual last user turn newest first, unknown times last, without pinning live rows. Alt-T last turn, Alt-R repository, Alt-G agent, Alt-O host/origin, Alt-V session select immutable snapshot sorting; text modes ascend with newest turn and stable identity ties and natural numeric session slots. Ctrl-A clears filters and preserves sort; Ctrl-F restores inactive/default filters and last-turn sorting. Search preserves the selected order. Narrow headers use ^ Ctrl and M Alt. Saved metadata refreshes on registered hosts by repository identity by default; --remote remains compatible. Canonical and verified renamed roots and swept rollouts are included. Exact IDs determine live ownership; independent saved conversations in occupied slots use guarded fresh allocation. Only selected transcripts are fetched. All-repository discovery includes repositories registered only on a reachable host and orphan Codex rollouts with exact Git metadata, even without local registrations. Metadata browsing and cancellation never clone or register repositories. Only a selected saved identity may create its guarded local checkout. GitHub transfers match only authenticated immutable repository IDs; selected different-name identities require fresh proof.

session resume.notes: Terminal launches run without echoing internal shell commands or exit instructions; agent output and diagnostics remain visible. Saved Codex resume resolves unindexed held sibling locks through validated session_meta workspace identity in active and archived rollouts. Unknown, invalid or unreadable evidence fails closed; ownership refusals return a concise retry diagnostic without a traceback.
